text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Her first race of the Senior Class.
The day of the Nikkei Shinshun Hai—the first goal
Meisho Doto chose for herself—had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*panic panic panic*...
What do I doooo?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Setting a goal for myself...
makes the pressure feel so completely different...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can... Can I really do it...?
But I was the one who said it, so...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, please calm down, Doto-san!
Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear, oh dear...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right!
I shouldn't be stoking anxiety like that.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I have to do this. I must.
And head toward the Spring GⅠ where Opera O is waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Awareness returned to Meisho Doto's eyes.
She has grown mentally stronger than before.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sniffle, sniffle... How truly admirable. Both Doto-san... and the Trainer who encourages her...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, look at how pathetic I am...
Even though I'm Doto-san's senior,
I can't do a single thing for her..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Still, at least for today, I have to cheer with everything I've got!
You can do it, Doto-san!
Make your dream come true, Doto-san!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering countless expectations on her own,
Meisho Doto stands on the graded race stage.
